label: Road-traffic noise, Lden

summary.unit: open-ground cells of 5 m inside the design site + 200 m, outside buildings

method.roads: OpenStreetMap; traffic flows assigned by road type (EU Good Practice Guide v2), not measured; speeds capped at the OSM maxspeed
method.buildings: 3DBAG LoD0 footprints, height = roof (50th pct) - ground
method.receivers: Delaunay grid at 1.75 m, design site + 200 m
method.reference_lines: Bkl municipal roads: 53 dB standard value, 70 dB limit value (façade values, used here as reference only)

limitations: Traffic is estimated from OSM road class, not counted.
Roads only: no rail, tram, metro or industry.
Flat ground; free-field levels at 1.75 m, not façade levels at 4 m.
